mapper.select: SELECT A.PRODID AS account, IFNULL(C.PBC_CODE,D.PROD_ID) AS pbcProdId, B.INDENTIFY_MARK AS indentifyMark, B.HOLDER_NAME AS holderName, B.HOLDER_TYPE AS holderType, A.HOLD_DATE AS holdDate, A.CCY AS ccy, A.QTY AS qty, A.AMOUNT AS amount FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A INNER JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B ON A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK AND B.STATUS != '03' LEFT JOIN PBC_PROD_ASSETPOOL_CODE C ON C.INSIDE_PROD_ID = A.PRODID LEFT JOIN PBC_COL_PRD_BASEINFO_SUB D ON A.PRODID = D.PROD_ID WHERE B.HOLDER_TYPE IN ('17','18','19','20','21','22') AND HOLD_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(HOLD_DATE) FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB WHERE HOLD_DATE < #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) GROUP BY C.INSIDE_PROD_ID,B.INDENTIFY_MARK,A.CCY
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PBC_TARGET_INFO WHERE ACCOUNT = #{account,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND INDENTIFY_MARK = #{indentifyMark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DATE_FORMAT(HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{holdDate,jdbcType=DATE}, '%Y-%m-%d')
